You may make use of my privilege,

Hic autem erat mos antiquitus in Israël inter propinquos,
Yet it was the custom between kinsmen in this former time in Israel,
ut siquando alter alteri suo juri cedebat,
that if at any time one yielded his right to another,
so as to confirm his permission,
the man took off his shoe
and gave it to his neighbor.
hoc erat testimonium cessionis in Israël.
This was a testimony of concession in Israel.
And so Boaz said to his kinsman,
